name: Kaerimichi wa Kiken ga Ippai
original_name: 帰り道は危険がいっぱい
source:
Hero fell in love with the daughter school president who is also a student council president. And her father will not tolerate that.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男主爱上了女校校长的女儿，而她同时也是学生会长。她的父亲绝不会容忍这段恋情。

[摘自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
